theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The only trend-eligible theme with leader status, positive score, and durability above the 0.5 hurdle. Rank-IC is ~0 so this is NOT a momentum buy; the lean rests on the absolute-trend gate keeping it in the eligible set while breadth remains strong (0.708) and not crowded (z 0.59). As the regime leader with the widest margin over the challenger (0.342) and healthy absorption (0.31, i.e. not a one-narrative blowoff), the theme holds trend-discipline continuity, not fresh alpha.
evidence: gate_helps=true (trend gate validated as risk control on this market)
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure is the most crowded narrative in the market universally, and the scorer's own val_state is 'fading' with hurst_tag 'mixed' — the composition may already price in a capex cycle that turns with any datacenter demand revision; a trend-gate pass only tells you it hasn't broken trend YET, not that it won't.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its own 50-day trend line or loses more than 5% relative to SPY before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Not a directional fade (explicitly forbidden on crowding); the lean is a sizing caution expressed as underweight relative to the eligible leader. Cybersecurity passes the trend gate with the highest durability in the set (0.85) and full breadth (1.0), but crowding_z=1.8 and crowded=true flag it as the most extended eligible theme. Crowding is a size-down signal only — not a short, not a sell, and not a basket drawdown timer.
evidence: guardrails: crowding only DOWN-SIZES, never fade
theses.dissent: A crowding tag has no basket-level forward edge per the backtest verdict — trimming it cuts exposure to a theme with perfect breadth and the strongest trend-health score, which is precisely the kind of high-durability, high-breadth leader that can run longer than any crowding metric anticipates.

falsifier.text: Cybersecurity's crowded flag clears (crowding_z falls below ~1.2) while durability_bar stays above 0.8 before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: One of only a handful of non-AI-chain themes that is trend-eligible (eligible=true, hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar=0.68). Rank 4 and score ~1.0, with breadth 0.727 and crowding_z 0.83 (not extended). The lean is breadth/rotation diversification expressed as a directional lean on a still-trend-eligible theme — NOT a momentum call (rank-IC ~0). Energy's trend-health is similar to the leader without the AI-chain correlation.
evidence: rotation.frac=0.39 (narrowing eligibility — staying in trend discipline)
theses.dissent: Energy is discounting a demand story that hinges on sustained AI/datacenter power load; any global growth scare or OPEC+ unwind resets oil quickly, and the theme's score (1.005) is barely above the Mag7 (0.795) with no independent catalyst beyond the same AI narrative.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its own 50-day trend line or the energy complex loses 5% relative to SPY before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
